data.long_meaning: The meaning of Avitzur is recorded in name-lists as “Bird of prey”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Avitzur expresses “Bird of prey”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avitzur total 36, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

in_hebrew.name: אביצור
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Avitzur is derived from the Hebrew words 'av' (father) and 'tsur' (rock or refuge), meaning 'Father of Light'. In the Hebrew Bible, there is no character named Avitzur.

in_greek.name: Αβιτζούρ
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Avitzur does not have a direct equivalent in the Greek language. However, it can be translated as 'Pater Lucis' (Father of Light).

in_latin.name: Avitusor
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Avitusor is derived from the Hebrew name Avitzur, meaning 'Father of Light'. It was used by the Knights Templar, a Christian military order, during the Middle Ages.
